wdUNnC_M{iHA.+*hd)RH.text: NU stands for no user. You can  change this to whatever you'd like, but keep it under 3 characters so it can't be a actual scratch username

cg.text:
Just determines how big your leaderboard is. 

Depending on how much data you are trying to store could impact how many items you should have. (Everyone's case is different you should calculate the max amount of data a single person can get and divide that among 253 which is Scratch's max limit in cloud variable length. I have a custom block to do all this to the left.)

ch.text: Determines if users are allowed to have their name up on the leaderboard more than once. (0 = no; 1 = yes)

ci.text: Scratch allows a cloud variable to be updated once every 0.1 seconds. If you are updating this at fast speeds I recommend setting this to 1 else keep this at 0
